<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Tiqkets · Your Ticket</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#E9E6DF;
    --card:#FBFAF7;
    --field:#F1EFE9;
    --line:#E3DFD5;
    --ink:#26221C;
    --ink-soft:#5C564B;
    --taupe:#A29881;
    --taupe-deep:#847A64;
    --brand:#9C1A5B;
    --brand-tint:#F6E4ED;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
  body{
    font-family:'Poppins',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
    background-color:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    min-height:100vh;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    padding:34px 18px 70px;
  }

  /* ---------- page header ---------- */
  .topbar{
    width:100%;max-width:430px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:18px;padding:0 6px;
  }
  .wordmark{font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.4px;color:var(--brand)}
  .wordmark span{color:var(--ink)}

  /* ---------- ticket card ---------- */
  .ticket-shell{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;max-width:430px;
    container-type:inline-size;
    filter:
      drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(50,42,28,.08))
      drop-shadow(0 14px 28px rgba(50,42,28,.12))
      drop-shadow(0 34px 60px rgba(50,42,28,.10));
    animation:rise .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both;
  }
  .ticket{
    position:relative;
    width:100%;
    background:var(--card);
    border-radius:24px;
    /* Real half-circle cuts punched out of the ticket:
       two at the banner seam (left + right) and one at the bottom center.
       Banner height = 38cqw (aspect-ratio 1000/380), so the seam sits at y=38cqw. */
    --seam:38cqw;
    -webkit-mask-image:
      radial-gradient(circle 16px at 0% var(--seam), transparent 15.5px, #000 16.5px),
      radial-gradient(circle 16px at 100% var(--seam), transparent 15.5px, #000 16.5px),
      radial-gradient(circle 36px at 50% 100%, transparent 35.5px, #000 36.5px);
    mask-image:
      radial-gradient(circle 16px at 0% var(--seam), transparent 15.5px, #000 16.5px),
      radial-gradient(circle 16px at 100% var(--seam), transparent 15.5px, #000 16.5px),
      radial-gradient(circle 36px at 50% 100%, transparent 35.5px, #000 36.5px);
    -webkit-mask-composite:source-in;
    mask-composite:intersect;
  }
  @keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .ticket-shell{animation:none}
    .live .dot{animation:none}
  }

  .banner-wrap{position:relative}
  .banner{
    display:block;width:100%;
    aspect-ratio:1000/380;object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;
  }
  .banner-fade{
    position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;
    background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.08),transparent 30%,transparent 72%,rgba(38,30,18,.28));
  }

  .body{padding:26px 28px 6px}

  /* restaurant row */
  .row-restaurant{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-bottom:26px}
  .icon-circle{
    flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--field);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .restaurant{min-width:0;flex:1}
  .restaurant .name{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2px;line-height:1.25}
  .restaurant .sub{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--taupe-deep);margin-top:2px}
  .chip{
    flex:none;background:var(--brand-tint);color:var(--brand);
    font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.6px;text-transform:uppercase;
    padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;
  }

  /* booking + qr */
  .row-booking{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
  .eyebrow{
    font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2.6px;
    color:var(--taupe-deep);text-transform:uppercase;
  }
  .booking-left .eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .booking-id{font-size:54px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1}
  .booking-hint{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--taupe-deep);margin-top:12px}

  .qr-frame{flex:none;position:relative;padding:14px}
  .qr-frame .corner{position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;border:2.5px solid var(--taupe)}
  .corner.tl{top:0;left:0;border-right:0;border-bottom:0;border-radius:9px 0 0 0}
  .corner.tr{top:0;right:0;border-left:0;border-bottom:0;border-radius:0 9px 0 0}
  .corner.bl{bottom:0;left:0;border-right:0;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 0 9px}
  .corner.br{bottom:0;right:0;border-left:0;border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 9px 0}
  #qr{
    width:142px;height:142px;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(50,42,28,.08);
  }
  #qr img,#qr canvas{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;image-rendering:pixelated}

  /* perforation */
  .perforation{
    position:relative;height:0;margin:30px 0 26px;
    background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 55%,transparent 45%);
    background-size:14px 2px;background-repeat:repeat-x;
    padding-top:2px;
  }

  /* guest details grid */
  .details{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px 16px;margin-bottom:26px}
  .detail{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;min-width:0}
  .detail.full{grid-column:1/-1}
  .icon-sq{
    flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px;
    background:var(--field);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .detail .eyebrow{margin-bottom:4px}
  .detail .value{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.3;
    white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

  /* instruction */
  .instruction{
    display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;
    background:var(--field);border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:16px;padding:15px 18px;margin-bottom:8px;
  }
  .instruction p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .instruction strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

  .footer-space{height:40px}

  /* ---------- ticket status card ---------- */
  :root{
    --amber:#C1712C;
    --amber-deep:#A85B1D;
    --amber-tint:#FBF3E3;
    --amber-line:#EFD9AE;
    --green:#3BA85C;
  }
  .status{
    width:100%;max-width:430px;
    background:var(--card);
    border-radius:24px;
    margin-top:22px;
    padding:24px 26px 26px;
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 2px rgba(50,42,28,.06),
      0 12px 28px rgba(50,42,28,.10);
    animation:rise .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) .12s both;
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.status{animation:none}}
  .status-head{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    margin-bottom:22px;
  }
  .live{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
    background:#E9F4E9;color:#2E7D42;
    font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.4px;
    padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;
  }
  .live .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.live .dot{animation:none}}

  .steps{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:22px}
  .step{flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;width:58px}
  .step .ring{
    width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;
    background:#DDD8CC;
  }
  .step.active .ring{
    background:var(--card);
    border:3.5px solid var(--amber);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #F4E3C5;
  }
  .step .name{
    font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.8px;
    text-transform:uppercase;color:#B3AB9B;
  }
  .step.active .name{color:var(--amber-deep)}
  .connector{
    flex:1;height:2.5px;border-radius:2px;
    background:#E4E0D5;margin-top:8px;
  }

  .position{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
    background:var(--amber-tint);
    border:1px solid var(--amber-line);
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:18px 22px;
  }
  .position .ic-wrap{
    flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
    background:#F6E8CC;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .position svg{stroke:var(--amber-deep)}
  .position .num{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:var(--amber-deep);line-height:1.1}
  .position .sub{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:#8A6A3C;margin-top:2px}

  .powered{
    margin-top:26px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;
    letter-spacing:.4px;color:var(--taupe-deep);
  }
  .powered b{color:var(--brand);font-weight:700}

  svg.ic{stroke:var(--taupe-deep);fill:none;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

  @media (max-width:390px){
    .booking-id{font-size:42px}
    #qr{width:118px;height:118px}
    .details{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="wordmark">tiq<span>kets</span></div>
    <div class="eyebrow" style="letter-spacing:2px">Ticket · T005</div>
  </div>

  <div class="ticket-shell">
  <article class="ticket" aria-label="Dine-in queue ticket">

    <div class="banner-wrap">
      <img class="banner" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Dishes served at Kuniamuthur">
      <div class="banner-fade"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="body">

      <div class="row-restaurant">
        <span class="icon-circle">
          <svg class="ic" width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 2v8M4.5 2v5a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 5 0V2M7 12v10"/><path d="M17 2c-1.7 0-3 2-3 5s1.3 5 3 5v10M17 2v10"/></svg>
        </span>
        <div class="restaurant">
          <div class="name">Kuniamuthur</div>
          <div class="sub">Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu</div>
        </div>
        <span class="chip">Dine-in</span>
      </div>

      <div class="row-booking">
        <div class="booking-left">
          <div class="eyebrow">
            <svg class="ic" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 9V7a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v2a3 3 0 0 0 0 6v2a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-2a3 3 0 0 0 0-6Z"/></svg>
            Booking ID
          </div>
          <div class="booking-id">T005</div>
          <div class="booking-hint">Scan at the counter</div>
        </div>
        <div class="qr-frame">
          <span class="corner tl"></span><span class="corner tr"></span>
          <span class="corner bl"></span><span class="corner br"></span>
          <div id="qr" role="img" aria-label="QR code for booking T005"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="perforation"></div>

      <div class="details">
        <div class="detail full">
          <span class="icon-sq">
            <svg class="ic" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="2.5" y="4.5" width="19" height="15" rx="3"/><circle cx="8.5" cy="11" r="2.1"/><path d="M5.7 16.3c.6-1.5 1.6-2.2 2.8-2.2s2.2.7 2.8 2.2M14.5 9.5H18.8M14.5 13H18.8"/></svg>
          </span>
          <div>
            <div class="eyebrow">Guest</div>
            <div class="value">Thiagu Raju</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="detail">
          <span class="icon-sq">
            <svg class="ic" width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3.2 1.8"/></svg>
          </span>
          <div>
            <div class="eyebrow">Joined at</div>
            <div class="value">04:52 PM</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="detail">
          <span class="icon-sq">
            <svg class="ic" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="8" r="3"/><path d="M3.5 19c.6-3 2.8-4.6 5.5-4.6S13.9 16 14.5 19"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="9" r="2.4"/><path d="M16.8 14.6c2.1.2 3.5 1.6 4 3.9"/></svg>
          </span>
          <div>
            <div class="eyebrow">Party size</div>
            <div class="value">4 guests</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="instruction">
        <svg class="ic" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="flex:none;margin-top:1px"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 7.5v.5"/></svg>
        <p>Show this QR ticket at the entrance. Head to reception within <strong>2 minutes</strong> of being called.</p>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="footer-space"></div>
  </article>
  </div>

  <section class="status" aria-label="Ticket status">
    <div class="status-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">Ticket Status</div>
      <div class="live"><span class="dot"></span>Live</div>
    </div>

    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step active">
        <span class="ring"></span>
        <span class="name">Joined</span>
      </div>
      <span class="connector"></span>
      <div class="step">
        <span class="ring"></span>
        <span class="name">Called</span>
      </div>
      <span class="connector"></span>
      <div class="step">
        <span class="ring"></span>
        <span class="name">Serving</span>
      </div>
      <span class="connector"></span>
      <div class="step">
        <span class="ring"></span>
        <span class="name">Done</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="position">
      <span class="ic-wrap">
        <svg class="ic" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3.2 1.8"/></svg>
      </span>
      <div>
        <div class="num">12th</div>
        <div class="sub">in queue · ~220 min wait</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="powered">Powered by <b>Tiqkets</b></div>

<script>
  new QRCode(document.getElementById("qr"), {
    text: "TIQKETS|KUNIAMUTHUR|T005|THIAGU-RAJU|2026-07-22T16:52",
    width: 300, height: 300,
    colorDark: "#26221C", colorLight: "#ffffff",
    correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M
  });
</script>
</body>
</html>
